propositions: A standing per-criterion effectiveness recorder is needed that computes detection and blocking-FP proxies from sidecar re-review history alone, without outcome-corpus git-walks or LLM calls, to enable advisory criteria auto-inclusion and promotion gating.

The recorder appends one firing row per (review-round, finding) to an append-only, prune-immune ledger (criterion_firings.jsonl) using envelope identity (ts_ns, round_uuid) parsed from sidecar filenames and per-finding data (criteria, norm_id, decision, drop_reason) from the payload.

The --report mode computes over a trailing window: detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units remediated to later PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction later de-escalated/dropped and never remediated), with null rates when denominators are zero.

The recorder auto-includes every criterion id observed, requires no per-criterion registration, and is idempotent via dedup key (ticket, review_ts, round_uuid, norm_id), supporting both --backfill and incremental --record modes.

The solution is deterministic instrumentation (zero LLM cost) that complements R7's outcome-corpus metric with a within-review signal and enables standing monitoring of advisory criteria without git-object walks or batch evaluations.
